name: stickman-open-world

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/verify-no-devtools.mjs dist
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android && node scripts/verify-no-devtools.mjs android/app/src/main/assets/public
scripts.android:apk: bun run build && cap sync android && cd android && node ../scripts/verify-no-devtools.mjs app/src/main/assets/public && ./gradlew assembleDebug && node ../scripts/verify-no-devtools.mjs app/build/outputs/apk

description: 2D open-world stickman fighting game (Phaser 3 + React + TypeScript)
